presets.name: Gatsby toast
presets.description: The uploaded person raises a champagne coupe in a golden 1920s party as fireworks burst behind them.
presets.prompt: Use the uploaded portrait as the identity reference. Create one continuous four-second medium close-up of the same person as an elegant host at a lavish 1920s mansion party at night. Preserve their facial features, face shape, skin tone and hairstyle; dress them in a classic black tuxedo with a white shirt and bow tie. They look into the camera with a confident, warm smile and slowly raise a champagne coupe glass in a toast. Golden fireworks burst in the dark sky behind them, with warm bokeh party lights and soft golden light on their face. Subtle camera push-in, gentle glass movement, natural blink. Keep the face stable and recognizable throughout. No scene cuts, no text, no logos, no morphing.
